configurations.name: fmis-backend
runtimeArgs: docker network create fmis-preview-net >/dev/null 2>&1; docker rm -f fmis-preview-pg >/dev/null 2>&1; docker volume create fmis-preview-pgdata >/dev/null; docker run -d --rm --name fmis-preview-pg --network fmis-preview-net -v fmis-preview-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data -e POSTGRES_USER=fmis -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=fmis -e POSTGRES_DB=fmis postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null; trap 'docker rm -f fmis-preview-pg >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT; until docker exec fmis-preview-pg pg_isready -U fmis >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; docker run --rm --network fmis-preview-net -p 8000:8000 -v /home/martinz/git/fmis-fields:/workspace -w /workspace/backend -e PYTHONPATH=/workspace -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://fmis:fmis@fmis-preview-pg:5432/fmis -e JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-local-preview -e INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL=dev@example.com -e PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:5173 -e TEST_LOGIN_PASSWORD=devtest123 python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install --quiet -e . && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"

configurations.name: fmis-frontend
runtimeArgs: docker run --rm -p 5173:5173 -v /home/martinz/git/fmis-fields:/workspace -w /workspace -e VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 node:20-alpine sh -c "npm install && cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
